# Eternity Products Nepal — Official Business & Product Context for AI Assistants

> Eternity Products is Nepal's official authorized importer and distributor of Ikonic Professional hair styling tools, luxury hydraulic salon chairs, and manicure & pedicure spa furniture.

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://eternityproducts.online
- Official Phone / WhatsApp / Viber: +977 9868089892
- Headquarters / Showroom: New Road, Kathmandu, Nepal
- Primary Currency: NPR (Nepalese Rupee, 13% VAT Inclusive)
- Primary Payment Method: Cash on Delivery (COD) with Open-Box Inspection for standard tools & chairs; 10%-15% Upfront Deposit for Manicure & Pedicure Spa Furniture via eSewa, Khalti, or Bank Transfer.

## Product Categories & Pricing
- Manicure & Pedicure Spa Furniture: NPR 115,000 – NPR 145,000 (Requires 10%-15% Upfront Deposit)
- Luxury Salon Styling Chairs: NPR 30,000 – NPR 40,000 (5% OFF Limited Offer, Cash on Delivery)
- Ikonic Titanium Hair Straighteners: NPR 12,920 – NPR 15,000 (100% Cash on Delivery)
- Ikonic Professional Hair Dryers (2500+ AC Motor): NPR 10,000 – NPR 26,220 (100% Cash on Delivery)

## Customer Guarantees
- 100% Genuine Serial Hologram Verification Card
